newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine 3-, 6-mo T-bills yields hold steady.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine 3-, 6-mo T-bills yields hold steady.

text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills stood at 53.92 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 17, a Ukrainian central bank official said on Thursday.
Results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of three-month T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 5.432 million UAH 36.745 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.789 million UAH 32.390 million UAH
Ukraine's central bank sold 54,324 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of discount three-month T-bills is scheduled for Thursday.
Average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills stood at 56.66 percent, the same as at the last sale on September 17, a central bank statement said.
The results of Wednesday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 14 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for Thursday.
